identificationModule.briefTitle: A Randomized, Two-cohort, Prospective Phase II Clinical Study of the Second-line Treatment of Advanced Biliary System Tumors With Liposomal Irinotecan (II) Combination Regimen
identificationModule.officialTitle: Liposomal Irinotecan (II) and Fluorouracil and Calcium Folinate in Combination With or Without Renvastinib for Second-line Treatment of Advanced Biliary System Tumors: a Randomized, Two-cohort, Prospective Phase II Study

leadSponsor.name: Cancer Institute and Hospital, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a randomized, two-cohort, multicenter Phase II clinical study. To evaluate the efficacy and safety of liposomal irinotecan II and 5-FU/LV combined with or without renvastinib in the treatment of patients with advanced biliary system tumors, 90 patients were scheduled to be enrolled.

interventions.name: Liposomal irinotecan+5-FU/LV+Lenvatinib
interventions.description: Liposomal irinotecan II: calculated as free base, 56.5 mg/m2, IV, d1q2w Renvastinib: ≥60kg, 12mg; \<60kg, 8mg, PO, once daily 5-FU: 1200 mg/ (m2·d) x2d continuous intravenous infusion for 46-48h, q2w LV: 400 mg/m2 intravenously, d1 q2w

interventions.name: NALIRI
interventions.description: Liposomal irinotecan II: calculated as free base, 56.5 mg/m2, IV, d1q2w 5-FU: 1200 mg/ (m2·d) x2d continuous intravenous infusion for 46-48h, q2w LV: 400 mg/m2 intravenously, d1 q2w

primaryOutcomes.description: The time between participant randomization and first recorded disease progression or death from any cause, whichever occurs first.

secondaryOutcomes.description: Patients were randomized to the time of death from any cause.
The proportion of participants in the analyzed population with confirmed complete (CR) or partial response (PR) based on RECIST v1.1
Percentage of cases with confirmed complete response, partial response, and stable disease (≥ 8 weeks) in patients for whom response could be evaluated.
Adverse events (AE)/Serious Adverse Events (SAE) (as determined by NCI-CTCAE 5.0).
